response.sql: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / HCT) as ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as overall_avg FROM patient_ratios), above_overall AS (SELECT pr.ID, pr.ratio, pr.ratio - oa.overall_avg as above_overall FROM patient_ratios pr CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE pr.ratio > oa.overall_avg), group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as group_avg FROM above_overall), final_group AS (SELECT ao.ID, ao.ratio, ao.above_overall, ao.ratio - ga.group_avg as above_group FROM above_overall ao CROSS JOIN group_avg ga WHERE ao.ratio > ga.group_avg) SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio, AVG(above_overall) as avg_above_overall, AVG(above_group) as avg_above_group FROM final_group
